# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 5 tokens; Text — 5 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 10 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 10 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-canvas);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `surface-canvas` | #fbfaf7 | Page background for every reading surface. Warm paper white, never pure white — keeps long sessions from feeling clinical. |
| `surface-raised` | #ffffff | Cards, sheets, modals, the comparison panel, popovers — anything that sits above canvas. |
| `surface-sunken` | #f3f1ec | Secondary surfaces set back from reading: side navigation, the Structural Reading panel ground, inactive tab wells. |
| `surface-overlay` | rgba(33,32,28,0.45) | Scrim behind modals and bottom sheets (reading-mode picker, book/chapter picker). |
| `surface-selected` | #e4ecdf | Background for the selected row in a picker list (book, chapter, translation, view mode). |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--ink-primary);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ink-primary` | #211f1a | Bible text and primary reading content. The highest-priority color in the system — reserved for what the user came to read. |
| `ink-secondary` | #57534a | Supporting UI text: breadcrumb, labels, chapter headings, translation names, verse numbers at rest. |
| `ink-tertiary` | #8a8577 | Muted metadata: timestamps, placeholder text, disabled control labels, footnote markers. |
| `ink-on-accent` | #ffffff | Text and icons placed on a filled accent-greek-700 or accent-hebrew-700 surface (primary buttons, active pill). |
| `ink-on-accent-tint` | #2c4f34 | Text and icons placed on a light accent tint (accent-greek-100/hebrew-100), e.g. the selected row in a picker. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--accent-greek-050);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accent-greek-050` | #f5f8f3 | Faintest Greek/Product wash — hover background for nav rows in the Greek (current) product. |
| `accent-greek-100` | #e4ecdf | Selected-state fill: active nav item, selected translation row, active tab underline background. |
| `accent-greek-300` | #93b389 | Secondary accent: progress indicators, decorative rules on Brand/About surfaces, chart-adjacent uses. Not for body text (fails contrast on paper). |
| `accent-greek-600` | #3c6b45 | Hover/pressed state for accent-greek-700 controls, and for icon-only accents at rest (e.g. the active reading-mode icon). |
| `accent-greek-700` | #2c4f34 | The Product Accent for 聖書［緑版］ — Greek Bible identity. Primary buttons, the active segmented-control pill, selected navigation state, key interactive elements. Meets 4.5:1 on surface-canvas and surface-raised; use ink-on-accent for text on top of it. |
| `accent-hebrew-050` | #fbf3f1 | Reserved for 聖書［赤版］ (future Hebrew product). Faintest Hebrew/Product wash — parallel role to accent-greek-050. Not used in the current Greek-only build. |
| `accent-hebrew-100` | #f0dcd5 | Reserved for 聖書［赤版］. Selected-state fill, parallel role to accent-greek-100. |
| `accent-hebrew-300` | #c98f7c | Reserved for 聖書［赤版］. Secondary accent, parallel role to accent-greek-300. |
| `accent-hebrew-600` | #8a4530 | Reserved for 聖書［赤版］. Hover/pressed state, parallel role to accent-greek-600. |
| `accent-hebrew-700` | #732f1e | Reserved Product Accent for 聖書［赤版］ (Hebrew Bible identity), same structural role as accent-greek-700, for when the product family ships Hebrew. Meets 4.5:1 on surface-canvas with ink-on-accent. Do not use in the current Greek product. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--border-hairline);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `border-hairline` | #e6e2d7 | Default 1px dividers: between verses' hit areas, list rows, the top-bar underline, table-of-contents rules. |
| `border-strong` | #cdc7b6 | Input borders, the segmented control's outer edge, structural-node card borders — anything that must read as a boundary, not a hint. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--structural-function-fill);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value */
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `structural-function-fill` | #e7edf6 | Structural Reading: FUNCTION layer fill (subject / verb / object / complement boxes) in the Reed–Kellogg-style diagram. |
| `structural-function-ink` | #32517d | Structural Reading: label text and border on FUNCTION boxes. Meets 4.5:1 on structural-function-fill. |
| `structural-construction-fill` | #ece6f5 | Structural Reading: CONSTRUCTION layer fill (apposition, coordination, clause groupings). |
| `structural-construction-ink` | #5a4785 | Structural Reading: label text and border on CONSTRUCTION boxes. Meets 4.5:1 on structural-construction-fill. |
| `structural-morphology-fill` | #e6f0ea | Structural Reading and word-order mode: MORPHOLOGY layer fill (case, tense, mood tags on a word chip). |
| `structural-morphology-ink` | #316148 | Structural Reading: label text on MORPHOLOGY chips. Meets 4.5:1 on structural-morphology-fill. Deliberately a different lightness from structural-function-ink and accent-greek-700 so FUNCTION, MORPHOLOGY and the product accent stay distinguishable without relying on hue alone. |
| `structural-connector` | #a49c86 | Tree lines and brackets joining structural nodes. Never carries meaning alone — always paired with the connected boxes' own layer color. |
| `signal-attention-fill` | #faf0da | Sparse, non-alarming notices only: a translation gap, a textual variant note, a beta/roadmap label. Never for errors framed as urgent — this is a reading app, not an operational dashboard. |
| `signal-attention-ink` | #8a5a14 | Text and icon on signal-attention-fill. Meets 4.5:1. |
| `focus-ring` | #211f1a | 2px keyboard-focus outline, offset 2px from the element, on every focusable control. Deliberately ink, not a hue, so focus is never confused with product accent, selection or structural meaning. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-ui-caption);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-ui-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui-caption` | `.ui-caption`, `--text-ui-caption` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `ui-sans` | Verse numbers, timestamps, structural role tags in the tab bar. |
| `ui-label` | `.ui-label`, `--text-ui-label` | 13px / 18px | 500 | `ui-sans` | Breadcrumb segments, bottom-navigation labels, form field labels. |
| `ui-body` | `.ui-body`, `--text-ui-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `ui-sans` | Menu rows, picker list items, panel body copy, button labels. |
| `ui-title` | `.ui-title`, `--text-ui-title` | 17px / 24px | 600 | `ui-sans` | Panel and sheet titles ("読み方を選ぶ"), section headings inside Research surfaces. |
| `ui-display` | `.ui-display`, `--text-ui-display` | 22px / 28px | 600 | `ui-sans` | Chapter heading in the reading surface itself (e.g. "ローマ人への手紙 第1章"), used sparingly. |
| `verse-ja` | `.verse-ja`, `--text-verse-ja` | 17px / 34px | 400 | `reading-ja` | Primary Bible text in Single reading state, Japanese translations. Generous 2x line-height for long, unbroken sessions. |
| `verse-ja-comparison` | `.verse-ja-comparison`, `--text-verse-ja-comparison` | 16px / 30px | 400 | `reading-ja` | Bible text inside a Comparison pane (desktop side-by-side or mobile stacked) — one step smaller and denser than single reading so two translations both stay comfortably readable. |
| `verse-ja-compact` | `.verse-ja-compact`, `--text-verse-ja-compact` | 14px / 24px | 400 | `reading-ja` | Bible text used as reference/context only, e.g. the collapsed preview of a chapter in the book/chapter picker. |
| `verse-source` | `.verse-source`, `--text-verse-source` | 18px / 34px | 400 | `reading-source` | Greek New Testament / LXX running text when read as the primary text (Default view on the Greek text) or as interlinear source above a translation. Reserved family: also carries future Hebrew. |
| `word-source-inline` | `.word-source-inline`, `--text-word-source-inline` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `reading-source` | Individual Greek word tokens inside WORD_ORDER and STRUCTURE modes, and inside word-level research popovers. |
| `gloss-source` | `.gloss-source`, `--text-gloss-source` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `reading-source` | Small interlinear gloss under a source word (lemma, gloss) in WORD_ORDER mode. |
| `structural-tag` | `.structural-tag`, `--text-structural-tag` | 11px / 14px | 600 | `ui-sans` | FUNCTION / CONSTRUCTION / MORPHOLOGY role labels on a structural node ("主語", "同格", "前置詞句"). Set with letter-spacing in CSS, not in this token. |
| `structural-node-text` | `.structural-node-text`, `--text-structural-node-text` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `ui-sans` | The Bible words shown inside a structural node box — same reading-source or reading-ja family is layered on top via class composition; this style sets the box's default UI metrics. |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, tag internal padding. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Inline gaps: verse number to verse text, structural tag to its box edge. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Clause-level gap inside a structural breakdown; gap between a word and its interlinear gloss. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Panel and card internal padding; minimum vertical gap between consecutive verses in dense/compact contexts. |
| `space-5` | 24px | Default vertical rhythm between verses in Single reading — the primary reading cadence. |
| `space-6` | 32px | Paragraph-break spacing within a chapter; gap between the chapter heading and verse 1. |
| `space-7` | 48px | Translation-to-translation gap in stacked Mobile Comparison; gap between the reading surface and a footer/meta block. |
| `space-8` | 64px | Chapter-level top spacing on Desktop; separation between the Reading Surface and a fully different context (e.g. Research deep-dive header). |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 4px | Structural-node boxes, small tags and chips (MORPHOLOGY, CONSTRUCTION labels). |
| `radius-md` | 8px | Buttons, input fields, the book/chapter picker rows, cards. |
| `radius-lg` | 16px | Sheets and panels that rise from the edge of the screen: the mobile reading-mode sheet, the Research side panel on desktop. |
| `radius-pill` | 999px | Segmented control track and thumb (単一表示 / 比較表示), translation chips. |
